title: API: /connectors lists every source and sink type these scenarios use
summary: Reads GET /api/v1/connectors and checks that every source type (local, http, rss, website, postgres-cdc) and sink type (postgres, mongodb, clickhouse, elasticsearch, qdrant, relata, jsonl) used by the E scenarios is in the catalogue the console renders.
